title: Hearty Mediterranean Stew
description: A flavorful and comforting stew perfect for a cold day, packed with the warm aromas of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced celery and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the hearty beef stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Mediterranean seasoning, diced tomatoes, red wine (if using), and chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2-3 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme (optional).
